frontierDefinition: Directly observed AA displayed intelligence-versus-total-cost frontier; not recomputed from a subset.
scope: Complete displayed intelligence versus total evaluation cost Pareto line with all 691 catalog models selected; 173 eligible plotted points. This is not ValueRank's composite-quality frontier.

completeness.note: All 14 rendered Pareto-line vertices matched to SVG circles by coordinates, then to exact displayed intelligence-chart identities using public data-chart-item-id attributes. Numeric intelligence values are rounded public labels. Total cost is only captured for MiMo through public tooltips; other total costs remain null. No hidden page state or paid export accessed.
